Licence texts of the flatcc portable headers that carry their own, copied verbatim from
the opening comment of each file (BIND-9b-7, D-BIND-166). The folder as a whole is under
LICENSE beside this file (Apache-2.0), upstream flatcc's, which nanoarrow's copy dropped.
